top_3.text: The interesting part isn't that the agent runs on a stream. It's that you can rewind the stream and watch the agent's reasoning again, event by event.
Replayability is the quiet superpower: when an agent does something wrong, you replay the exact stream and watch it decide.
Three moves: Kafka remembers every event, Flink reacts continuously, the agent reasons over each one — and you can rewind all of it.

winner.text: When a streaming agent gets something wrong, you don't guess why. You replay the exact events it saw and watch the reasoning again — because Kafka never throws the stream away.

runner_up.text: The strongest version of 'AI should be event-driven' isn't speed. It's auditability: replay the stream, watch the agent decide, prove why.
